headlines.title: Visa, Mastercard, and Ant International Build First Cross-Network Know Your Agent Framework
headlines.summary: The Illusion of Unity in Agentic Finance On September 9 and 10, 2026, the payments industry witnessed a rare moment of public alignment. Visa, Mastercard, and Ant International announced the development of a Cross-Network Know Your Agent (KYA) interoperability framework. Convened under the auspices of the Monetary Authority of Singapore’s BuildFin.

headlines.title: Visa Just Fired 2,600 People. Here’s Where That Money Is Going
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysVisa’s fiscal Q3 2026 delivered 14% net revenue growth and a value-added services (VAS) line up 34% in constant dollars to $3. 8 billion, now 30% of total net revenue.

headlines.title: Visa’s Stablecoin Settlement Just Hit $20 Billion. The Rail Is Built Before the Rules Are.
headlines.summary: Visa has officially crossed the $20 billion annualized run rate for stablecoin settlement, a milestone that serves as a blunt instrument in the ongoing debate over the future of payment rails. The trajectory is not merely a steady climb; it is a vertical sprint. In late 2025, the volume sat at $3.5 billion.

headlines.title: Visa, MOONTON Games extend collaboration with new three-year partnership for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang's M Series-the world's most watched mobile esports tournament
headlines.summary: Visa, a global leader in digital payments, and MOONTON Games, the international video game developer behind Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB), today announced a three-year partnership to elevate the M Series experience for fans worldwide. The partnership sees Visa named the Global Payment Partner for the next three editions of the M Series—the M8 World Championship (M8) in 2027 through the M10 World Championship (M10) in 2029.

headlines.title: Visa Moves to Close Meme Coin Credit Card Rewards Loophole
headlines.summary: After banks lost their push for tighter stablecoin rules in the failed Clarity Act, JP Morgan scored a narrower win as Visa moves to stop meme coin purchases from being coded as ordinary "digital media" and earning card rewards.

description: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. The company operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. It provides its services under the Visa, Visa Electron, V PAY, Interlink, and PLUS brands. The company serves consumers, sellers, financial institutions, and government entities. Visa Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
